zespol.name: Patrycja Słomczyńska
zespol.cytat:
The privilege of a lifetime is to become who you truly are.
- Carl Gustav Jung
zespol.cytat_popup:
The privilege of a lifetime is to become who you truly are.
- Carl Gustav Jung
zespol.bio:
Who AM I really?

A violinist, an educator, a maker, a producer of artistic events and a creator of cultural places. Someone passionate about conscious education and growth, founder of the wonderful community that is The Noise Makers - a private arts school where we grow passion, where we learn to read reality through sensitivity, to understand emotion and to feel ourselves.

A lover of art and of getting to know people and the way they see the world.

An extra pair of eyes and ears: attentively seeing and hearing your children and you, and what you need.

A guide leading you to discover potential and natural aptitudes, shaping a personalised path of growth out of getting to know each person.

zespol.name: Justyna Bojczuk
zespol.cytat: If you can dream it, you can do it
zespol.cytat_popup: If you can dream it, you can do it
zespol.zajecia_grupowe: Vocal groups, Choir, Musical, Head of Musical + Acting, Write your own song
zespol.bio:
My name is Justyna.

I am a singer, a lover of sunshine and travel.  I grew up in a theatre and in a garden - two worlds that taught me sensitivity, presence and attention. I feel best in nature, that is where calm and harmony come to me most easily.

I look towards emotion, towards goodness and towards the inner voice. I believe that each of us carries a story unlike anyone else's, one that deserves to be heard and to be expressed.

Openness, understanding and respect matter to me. In my work with Students I do not focus only on the growth of the voice. 
I also help with discovering your own sensitivity, because that is where real contact with yourself and with others begins. Each of us is different, so what matters to me is looking at each person individually and following their needs attentively.

A meeting full of presence, mutual trust and respect gives rise to something good that, I believe, stays with us for a long time. I share what I find for myself in harmony, freedom and sensitivity. I believe that when we allow ourselves to be ourselves, our voice becomes true and authentic.

zespol.name: Adam Woch
zespol.cytat: Wiem coraz mniej i mniej, ale przynajmniej w coraz szerszej i szerszej perspektywie.
zespol.cytat_popup: Wiem coraz mniej i mniej, ale przynajmniej w coraz szerszej i szerszej perspektywie.
zespol.bio:
I AM
I am open to the other person. The small one and the grown one. In everyone I see someone to talk with and a spark for action.
I have always been able to lose myself in what I love, and Music, which has been with me for over 25 years, taught me hard work and humility. Today I step past my safe borders and set myself ambitious goals. I am learning to dream and looking inside myself for the courage to make those dreams real.

PATH
The artistic path has always been a goal in itself for me. Not only because Music, or Art more broadly, was always my passion, but above all because it is the process that gives the most satisfaction. In my case, finished projects leave behind not only joy but also a certain kind of emptiness. So I live in a constant search for processes, and one of them, one that never ends, is going deeper into the meanders of Music.

DIRECTION
Life today is an endless multitude of possibilities. More than ever we feel we are the masters of our own fate and that we can do anything. At the same time this endless number of chances and risks can overwhelm us. Every choice carries some loss. That is exactly why I feel that values play a very important part in our lives. They are what gives direction. For me they are openness, passion, friendship, acceptance and safety. And for you?

MEANING
Nothing discourages like a lack of meaning in what you do. I look for it in everything I take on. Meaning, for me, is reflection. On myself, on the world around us. It is not so hard to see. It is enough to give up some of the distractions around us and allow yourself to think, and sometimes even to be bored. The amount of information around us can be overwhelming. I try to look for many answers inside myself rather than in an internet search engine :)

zespol.name: Joanna Ciwińska
zespol.cytat: Music and art are a space of freedom and authenticity for me, tools that let me express myself (...)
zespol.cytat_popup: Music and art are a space of freedom and authenticity for me, tools that let me express myself, explore my own sensitivity and experience myself and the reality around us in an authentic, deep way.
zespol.bio:
I am an artist, a musician, but above all someone who believes that art is for every one of us - not the other way round. My path is constant growth, and it is growth that pushes me to act, to explore new spaces and to ask questions. I observe, I analyse, I look for solutions. I see the faults of the system and the beliefs that keep people away from art, and I want to change them.

Music and art are a space of freedom and authenticity for me, tools that let me express myself, explore my own sensitivity and experience myself and the reality around us in an authentic, deep way. Through my artistic and educational work I want to show that they are closer to us than we might think, and that we can use them on our own terms.
Because we do not choose art - art chooses us.

zespol.name: Aleksandra  Janusz
zespol.cytat: What fascinates me in people are the differences, the otherness and the fact that we can draw from one another.
zespol.cytat_popup: What fascinates me in people are the differences, the otherness and the fact that we can draw from one another.
zespol.bio:
I always try to follow the DIRECTION of my values. They matter to me above all, because without them I would not feel fully "human".

Wherever I am heading, I always choose the "harder" PATH. Why?
Because I am convinced it teaches us far more! The strength of will and of character we build by facing difficulty grounds us far more than easy solutions do.

I also hold to the rule that we reach happiness and fulfilment by treating the path as more important than the GOAL it leads us to.

What gives my life MEANING is faith in goodness and the sense that nothing happens without a reason.
What makes me happiest is being able to help someone and seeing the real effect of what I do.
So I find it hard to adapt to the rule that says: "put on your own oxygen mask first".

What fascinates me in people are the differences, the otherness and the fact that we can draw from one another. Differences of culture, of character, different ways of looking at the world. It hurts me a great deal when others are excluded because of their "otherness, their weakness". One of the values closest to my heart is held in the passage below:

A fragment of a poem by Fr. Jan Twardowski entitled "Justice":

"If everyone had four apples
if everyone were as strong as horses
if everyone were equally defenceless in love

if each of us had the same
no one would need anyone

Thank You that Your justice is inequality

what I have and what I do not have
even what I have no one to give to
is always needed by someone...
(unofficial translation)"

Music was never "just a job" to me. From childhood it filled my whole life and gave it many colours. Bright colours, dark ones, pale ones - and that is the most beautiful thing about it.

Routine has no right to creep into that world if we treat it with passion and humility. Being inside music teaches me to notice beauty, sensitivity, discipline, organisation, letting go, perspective, and it teaches me to dream. Music brought me the most important mentors of my life. I travelled to places whose memory will stay with me for the rest of my life. I heard performances that will ring in my ears as the greatest musical inspiration. With all my heart I recommend that everyone knock on that door one day and let music enrich their inner world.

zespol.name: Kajetan Pietrzak
zespol.cytat: Do what you love - and do it for real.
zespol.cytat_popup: Do what you love - and do it for real.
zespol.bio:
DIRECTION
I look towards truth in music. I want to play and create in a way that is honest and stays with people for longer. I am not interested in being only "technically good" - what matters to me is emotion, the message, the exchange with another person - through sound, through rhythm.

PATH
My path is constant learning - through playing, through listening and through sharing what I already know. I do not have a ready plan for the whole future, but I know I want to keep getting better, as a musician and as a teacher. I work so that every session, concert or class has meaning and quality.

MEANING
I find the greatest meaning in the moment when something I play or say touches another person. When I see that someone in class has discovered something important for themselves, or when together with the band we "carry" an audience somewhere - that gives me drive and confirms that it is worth it.

zespol.name: Aleksandra Michalak
zespol.cytat: The deepest practice is being exactly where you are.
zespol.cytat_popup: The deepest practice is being exactly where you are.
zespol.zajecia_grupowe: Emotion regulation, Relaxation concert, Yoga, Breathwork classes
zespol.bio:
As a yoga teacher and breath therapist I work with the body, the breath and attention as a way of meeting yourself - the way that is possible in a given moment. (My path began with getting to know the outer world, and over time it led more and more clearly to the inner one. Breath and yoga became a space for me where you can slow down, feel the body and see more than only what is on the surface.)

As a yoga teacher and breath therapist, what interests me is what happens in the body and in the moment that is going on right now. I am not looking for one goal or one place to arrive at. I see life as a process - full of change, experience and constant learning.

When I became a mother, I began to see many things differently. I understood how important calm, presence and attention are in everyday life. That is exactly what I want to share with others.
I create a space where you can slow down for a moment, take a breath and come back into contact with yourself. Without judgement, without hurry and without any need to be someone other than who you are.

Today I do what I believe is worth doing. I keep company with others as they meet their body, their breath and the present moment. If that helps someone feel calmer, look at themselves with more kindness or find a little more courage to live their own way - that is reason enough for me to keep going.

I do not teach great things, but I try to keep company as you notice what is already happening in the body, in life and in the depth of who we are.

I believe that presence does not change life, it changes the way we live it. I invite you to practise together - as a path, not a goal.

zespol.name: Maria Wierzbicka
zespol.cytat:
Inspiration exists, but it has to find you working.
- Pablo Picasso
zespol.cytat_popup:
Inspiration exists, but it has to find you working.
- Pablo Picasso
zespol.bio:
I look at myself, at what is happening around me, and into the future. Guided by my own sensitivity, I build teams with whom we move forward together. I want to create environments and carry out projects in which everyone feels safe and believes in what we want to say through art. I want to share what fascinates me, because that is what gives me the greatest joy.

My work is driven by curiosity and a constant search for new means of expression. There is one sentence my teacher passed on to me many years ago and I keep coming back to it. I hope it stays with me for my whole life, because I want to keep growing. Those are the words of Pablo Picasso: Inspiration exists, but it has to find you working. I believe that diligent work, consistency and constant searching lead to the best results.

zespol.name: Magdalena Rossowska
zespol.cytat: Search, try, discover. Do not be afraid to look deep (...)
zespol.cytat_popup:
Search, try, discover. Do not be afraid to look deep. If you follow what is honest and good, it is hard to really spoil anything.

"Remember, only the mad ones are worth anything"
- Alice in Wonderland
zespol.zajecia_indywidualne: Vocals, Voice training, Presentation - voice work
zespol.bio:
I look for the moments in which I lose myself. I feel that I am flying, soaring. In them everything is exactly as it should be, and I lift off the ground and simply am.

I would like everyone to discover their passion in life, their talent. The superpower that will let them find fulfilment. It is not an easy task, it often takes time. But once we find it, it gives us joy, a sense of fulfilment and the courage to walk our own path.

I look for the sounds that express my emotions. For me the magic of singing is that no performance is ever the same as the one before. Every piece takes on new colours, because each time I meet it with a different weight of emotion, experience and story.

I believe that every person has an unrepeatable voice inside them - not only the one we hear, but also their own way of expressing themselves.

Search, try, discover. Do not be afraid to look deep. If you follow what is honest and good, it is hard to really spoil anything.

"Remember, only the mad ones are worth anything"
- Alice in Wonderland

zespol.name: Justyna Żołnacz
zespol.cytat: Life is not measured by the number of breaths we take, but by the moments that take our breath away
zespol.cytat_popup: Life is not measured by the number of breaths we take, but by the moments that take our breath away
zespol.bio:
I am a pianist, a student, a lover of art, an artistic and sensitive soul. I keep looking for new inspiration that shapes my personality and moves me to create. I am an optimist who believes that everything in life happens for a reason. I walk through life with courage and with care. Heading towards a sense of fulfilment, satisfaction and inner calm. To be here and now, to catch fleeting moments attentively. I am, therefore I feel, I think and I act. I notice the beauty around me and the kindness that comes from people.

Path
It is extraordinarily precious, it can be rough and hard, yet it carries many important experiences, lessons and chances to grow.
It is beautiful because it is ours, and every goal we reach along the way is only the cherry on top. There is no goal without a path. There are no dreams fulfilled without effort and sacrifice. Thanks to discipline and determination our path will take us to many wonderful and fulfilling experiences.

"Life is an art of discovery. Do not be afraid of new experiences, they are its essence."
Ernest Hemingway

Direction
I am guided by love, goodness and kindness. I pass on to others positive energy and optimism, which always comes back to me twice as strong.

"Life is a paradise, and the keys to it are in our own hands".
Fyodor Dostoyevsky

Meaning
The meaning of my life is passing on goodness, sharing beauty and becoming a better person every day, along with constant growth. I want to help people find their own meaning, both on their professional path and in their personal life.

"Life is not measured by the number of breaths we take, but by the moments that take our breath away".

zespol.name: Małgorzata Nowińska
zespol.cytat: The theatre has seen everything already. It has not seen us yet.
zespol.cytat_popup: The theatre has seen everything already. It has not seen us yet.
zespol.bio:
An actor full of passion and openness, a student of the Acting Faculty of the Aleksander Zelwerowicz Theatre Academy in Warsaw (specialising in dramatic acting). In her work and everyday life she looks for truth, emotion and authentic contact with another person.

Especially close to her heart are amateur youth theatres, where she sees a space of freedom, creative courage and the first honest meetings with the stage. She also draws inspiration from jazz - with its improvised nature and lively pulse - and from the practice of yoga, through which she finds harmony of body, mind and breath.

In 2024 she enriched her acting experience by taking part in the Comedy Improvisation Masterclass led by Mateusz Płocha - a meeting that opened her even more to spontaneity, humour and the unpredictability of what happens on stage.

She believes acting is not only an art, but also a path of inner growth - a constant discovery of yourself and the world through word, movement and silence.
Her acting path is filled with sensitivity, courage and a deep faith in the power of a true, human meeting.

At the centre of her approach to acting there is always the other person - their individuality, their emotions and their inner richness. She believes that accepting yourself and discovering your own "I" are the key to finding a true passion for acting and theatre.

In her work she tries to join solid foundations of technique with improvisation, which lets each person enrich their acting experience with personal feelings and reflections.

She gives great weight to developing attention, imagination and emotional sensitivity, seeing in them the foundation of authentic expression on stage.

She sees the creative process as a path that asks for mutual trust, openness and a readiness to search honestly for truth.

In her method she puts the emphasis on working with intuition and spontaneity, helping participants understand themselves better and build deep, true relationships on stage.

She carries the conviction that although many stories have already been told in the theatre, every new presence brings something unique.

Her motto is: "The theatre has seen everything already. It has not seen us yet".

zespol.name: Ania Sizalewska
zespol.cytat:
Path, not goal. 
I believe that fulfilment does not arrive when we finally reach the result we set out for. It is born much earlier - in the way we walk through life.
zespol.cytat_popup:
The path, not the goal.
I believe fulfilment does not appear only when we finally reach the result we set out for. It is born much earlier - in the way we walk through life.
zespol.bio:
I am someone who likes to look a little longer at people, at their stories and at what happens between the words.

For years I have been fascinated by the moment when something that seemed like chaos suddenly starts to make sense. That is why I listen, ask and look for connections.

In my work I deal with communication and strategy, but more and more often I see that whether I am talking with an artist, an entrepreneur or a child, the same thing interests me: how to find your own voice and the courage to use it.

I believe we do not always need new answers - sometimes we need new light on what is already there.

I look towards authenticity, courage and greater self-awareness. What interests me is not only what we do, but above all why we do it and what becomes possible because of it.

I am not looking for ready answers or for perfect versions of life. What interests me more is the process of getting to know yourself, learning the world and coming back again and again to what really matters.
I believe that growth does not begin when we try to become someone else, but when we agree, more and more boldly, to be ourselves.

You can move forward without constantly correcting yourself. You can grow without running away from who you are today.

zespol.name: Mateusz Kaczmarek
zespol.cytat: Listen to yourself. To your body, to your thoughts. Pause in the daily rush to notice the small moments of joy.
zespol.cytat_popup: Listen to yourself. To your body, to your thoughts. Pause in the daily rush to notice the small moments of joy.
zespol.bio: I am a husband and a dad. My path is building stability in small steps: through time with family, care for health, spiritual growth, relationships, passions and work that agrees with my values.

zespol.name: Natalia Narzelska
zespol.cytat:
The paradox of creativity is that we have to take seriously the business of treating ourselves lightly...
- Julia Cameron
zespol.cytat_popup:
The paradox of creativity is that we have to take seriously the business of treating ourselves lightly. We have to work at learning to play.
- Julia Cameron
zespol.bio:
I try to look for beauty in the everyday. I believe that even small things can affect the quality of our life and our happiness - the way we work, the way we rest, the way we talk to one another or shape the space around us. I value simplicity, authenticity and attention in relationships. 

I am a designer and an observer. I like to notice the connections between people, ideas and places. In my work I try to make things that are not only beautiful, but also needed. I choose projects, relationships and actions that agree with my values, that build something good and that give others something worthwhile.

I am a mother, a wife and a maker. These roles do not compete with one another, they run through one another. They teach me attention, patience, responsibility and how to see the value in ordinary moments. It is exactly the everyday, relationships and closeness that are my source of inspiration and my reminder of what really matters.

I believe that meaning is born where values meet action, and that beauty has its greatest value when it serves a person.

Give yourself room to work with it and to deepen the relationship with yourself.

Of speaking up.
Of freedom. Of ease. Of joy.

Sing and hear yourself.

Support your:
Power, Courage to express yourself, Breath, Release, Voice awareness, Cooperation with others.
Spend a relaxing time in a small circle for whom caring for themselves and the joy of music is a shared need, and where mutual support gives courage.

Hear your own voice.
Give yourself room to work with it and to deepen the relationship with yourself.

A small group is also a choice focused on discovering together, on joy and on
reaching shared goals.
Above all it is time that makes space for a smile and a sense of fulfilment.

Feel the power of release and the true joy of the sound and energy of a small group.

opinie.cytat: In every class I can learn something new. There is no stress when you do not know something, the teacher will try to help you. What is cool is that I can choose the pieces I am going to play. In class I can also record music videos and learn how to produce music. I can talk with my coach about all sorts of things too, games for example.

The teachers at TNM are very kind. Nothing happens under pressure. You can always count on help and you get it right away. You can talk with the teachers about anything and learn a lot. You are never bored, and the Head of the school is very kind too. I also learn interesting things about music, I play my favourite pieces and I keep growing.

TNM is a wonderful place, full of wonderful people and energy. The school has a family atmosphere and a non-standard approach to music and to every learner. (...) At TNM I play what I like, which makes learning easier and makes playing the guitar huge fun for me. (...) The teachers at TNM are world-class musicians who perform and keep growing, bringing new inspiration into every class.

As a parent I am enchanted - by the team and by how the classes run, and just as much by how my children react to their weekly meetings, by their eagerness to learn and to practise the next notes at home. Adam is not only a brilliant guitarist but also a wonderful teacher, who inspires, motivates, knows how to reach a child and pass on his musical spark (...). I really appreciate the flexibility and the chance to talk with the school's founder, Patrycja, an exceptionally sensitive, warm and remarkable person (...).

I am under enormous impression of The Noise Makers and the show they have prepared with kids. Singing, playing instruments, the whole performance was amazing and I enjoyed every bit of it. (...) It’s clear how much heart, passion, and hard work Mr Hugo put into working with the children in such a short time. (...) HUGE congratulations and thank you for making it such a memorable experience!
I think your approach is very good and it teaches a lot to the children and ;) to the parents.
My daughter really enjoyed the acting class and vocal too.

Today, right after waking up, Ola asked as her first words: "yesterday was Sunday, so today is Monday! is this the day we meet the ukulele teacher?". There is certainly enormous curiosity, excitement and anticipation for the next meeting.
The girls LOVE their classes at The Noise Makers. Thank you for being there and for taking such good care of us.

faq.a: The Noise Makers is a space where art meets psychology, so that children and adults can safely discover themselves through music, movement, theatre and expression. We build an environment based on relationships, authenticity and joy - with no pressure of being graded.

faq.q: Who are the classes at TNM for?
faq.a: The classes are for children from the age of 3 and for adults who want to grow their creativity, emotional awareness and confidence. We offer both peer groups and one-to-one classes shaped to what each participant needs.

We offer group classes (musical, acting, choir, movement, orchestra, yoga with music, meditation, voice training) and one-to-one and small group classes on instruments. We also run development consultations and holiday programmes.

faq.q: How can I check whether the classes will suit my child?
faq.a: We offer a short, free call online and a paid consultation 1:1 (45 min), in which we work out the best paths of growth together. That way you can consciously choose classes matched to your child's needs and temperament.

faq.q: Where do the classes take place?
faq.a: Group classes take place at Edison School in Wilanów. One-to-one classes and consultations are held in Warsaw - Wola, Wilanów, Ursus and Ursynów. We give the exact address once the date is booked.

faq.q: How do group classes differ from one-to-one ones?
faq.a: Group classes build relationships, cooperation and the joy of creating together in a safe atmosphere among peers. One-to-one classes (1:1) or small groups are fully personalised - we follow the pace and the needs of that one person.

A consultation is an individual, 30-minute meeting (in person or online) in which we look at natural potential and build a map of growth together. We also offer a short call online (15 min) and a free diagnostic quiz.

faq.q: Do you run day camps and holiday workshops?
faq.a: Yes - we run full holiday programmes with TNM in June - July, July - August and August - September 2026 at Royal Wilanów. It is a mix of creative workshops, movement, music and building relationships in a safe, small group.

faq.q: How do I sign my child or myself up for classes?
faq.a: The fastest way is the form on this site or an email to jestem@thenoisemakers.pl. You can also book a 1:1 call online right away, or fill in a short quiz that helps match the best classes.

Dear Patrycja,

The meeting with you was a pleasure for us both. Mikołajek was very happy afterwards and, despite it being the afternoon and him being tired after a whole day at school, you could not see that tiredness on him at all. He was full of good energy.
Thank you so much for all the interesting and very useful links.

Maja came into the house and said "I am so proud of myself".
I wanted to thank you for the meeting,
I think there are few people like you and you can feel it from the first sentence.
I am glad I trusted my intuition and found my way to you.
Maja was already practising here today!

She has just said that tomorrow she is going to make leaflets inviting people to her concert, and she will play and dance.

We are very grateful too, it was a wonderful experience. Kosma is thrilled :)

Thank you so much for such a detailed and constructive summary of Kosma's consultation. I feel every word of it.
Kosma and I are breathing every day now and I hope it becomes a habit for him.

Thank you so much for all the interesting and very useful links.
Thank you again for the meeting and for such a full and very kind email.
Your team is wonderful. And matching the right classes helped me a great deal, and it is working.
Thank you, Patrycja! Thanks to our conversation I learned a great deal about many things I do not see at home day to day. It really helps in building a relationship of trust with my child.

Patrycja, they loved it! 
Even Tobi was super happy, told me it was amazing.
He wants to play the piano!
It was perfect match after our talk.  
Thank for perfect Tutors! Thank you.
Until now our girls had never had a Tutor matched to them so well. Thanks to that they feel at ease and safe. They love their vocal classes with Justyna. And at home they keep singing! Thank you.

Dear Patrycja,
Adaś and Ola found a common language and after today's class he was over the moon :) thank you!

Patrycja, Thank you !!! I really appreciate the way
 You managed this situation.
Not many education people unfortunately know how to do that. I have no words for your care. Thank you.

Matching the right classes and the right mentors, with such attention to a child's needs, is something completely out of the ordinary. Nowhere else have we met such attention and sensitivity to another person, or such thorough feedback, so supportive of the next decisions we make about our child's growth. From the first moment we felt we were in the right hands.
You have a wonderful team! Kajetan is a perfect match for Teo too. Thank you!
I think your approach is very good and it teaches a lot to the children and ;) to the parents.

We left TNM with a huge smile. Charged with very good energy for hours afterwards. Even driving out of the car park took a while, because we all wanted to say something:)
At home, over mugs of cocoa, we told each other what a wonderful atmosphere there was at the meeting at TNM..
Professionalism and warmth.
Those are the words that come to mind straight away - from the moment we walked in you crouched down to Ola's height and started speaking in a language matched to her needs. Waiting attentively for her answer and coming back to it later. Those are rare qualities, and very important ones in contact with Small People.

Thank you for passing on a passion for music in such a unique way, matched to Ola's needs, and all within a single hour. You could see it in how Ola felt right afterwards - the spontaneous play in that space showed how good she felt there, thanks to your involvement.

I feel enormous gratitude. The assessment is one thing, and it will certainly help Ola further along the way. We will gladly try a path at The Noise Makers.
But the chance to be in touch with you is something priceless. It is through your work and your commitment that we show Ola what kind of relationships with another person we want to build. I believe there is nothing more beautiful than that.
I appreciate the very special care you gave Bella and Ola! Thank you so much!

If you would like to meet us and get to know us, feel the atmosphere of our classes and experience education with us, choose the one-off “Let's meet” trial classes in the category of the regular classes you are interested in (Musical, Acting, Choir, Instrument).

After the trial classes we will assign you to the right group 
and match the classes to your needs.

After the trial days we will also ask you to confirm the location that suits you best.
